name: Regular Yogurt
siboNotes: High lactose content makes regular yogurt problematic for SIBO patients. Even small amounts may trigger symptoms due to bacterial fermentation of undigested lactose.
preparationTips: Choose Greek yogurt over regular for lower lactose content
Look for lactose-free varieties with live cultures
Start with very small portions (1-2 tablespoons) to test tolerance
Avoid flavored varieties which often contain high FODMAP additives
nutritionalHighlights: Good source of riboflavin and phosphorus
